title: Set up the integral
text: Integrate with respect to y: the area is the integral of $$x \frac{dy}{dt}$$ for $$t$$ from $$0$$ to $$\frac{\pi}{2}$$, which is the integral of $$cos\left(t\right) e^t$$.

title: Evaluate
text: An antiderivative of $$e^t cos\left(t\right)$$ is $$\frac{e^t \left(sin\left(t\right)+cos\left(t\right)\right)}{2}$$. Evaluating from $$0$$ to $$\frac{\pi}{2}$$ gives $$\frac{e^{\frac{\pi}{2}}-1}{2}$$.
